lane: two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998, doi:10.1145/279943.279962); View A potential-field and subsurface (geodetic strain bands 4/7/8 + isostatic gravity bands 13/18 cross-family control), View B surface (detrended elevation band 12, its slope band 19, aeroradiometric total count band 6); disagreement as the discovery signal; primary arm is the A-confident/B-abstains buried-fault quadrant
mechanism: odd-symmetric (signed dipole) fault-normal profile decomposition: odd=(B(+h)-B(-h))/2, even=(B(+h)+B(-h))/2 at h in {1,2} px along a visible-catalogue-measured fault normal quantised to 8 compass directions; discriminator is odd-dominance odd^2/(|odd|+|even|+eps) and the sign-reversal couple min(|B+|,|B-|)*1[sign differs]
named_non_fault_mimic: geodetic strain is a smooth interpolation of sparse GPS/InSAR observations: (i) station-density gradients and block-boundary smoothing seams create signed couples with no structure; (ii) magmatic inflation/deflation is dilatant by definition; (iii) post-seismic viscoelastic relaxation after the 1954 Fairview Peak and 1959 Hebgen Lake sequences; (iv) elastic strain on an already-mapped fault, removed by the 200 m catalogue ring
shared_tools_to_reuse: src/gems52/metric.py (literal published DTI transcription, pinned by tests/test_metric.py)
promotion_rule: promote only if the primary's paired 95% CI lower bound against single_B is above zero on gems52-pooled-hide-v1; otherwise NEGATIVE, research-only artefact, DOWNLOAD yes / SUBMIT no, 0 weekly slots spent

experiments: E1 channels + leakage canary + per-fold fit + OOF AUC
E2 independence screen + nine-budget matched hide-and-recover holdout
E3 build + lane/uniqueness gates + GeoTIFF + run card + site publication

Both containers have been portal-accepted, and the all-finite container cannot trip 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' under any reader.

thresholds_completion_note: receiver_rank_interval, min_pseudo_pixels, pseudo_cap_per_fold and universal_coverage_probe_threshold were transcribed verbatim from registry/h74_preregistration.json during the run, BEFORE the independence stage measured anything, because the first transcription omitted them and the stage raised KeyError. Transcription completion, not a re-tune: the abandon bar (0.60), donor rank (0.95), block side (50 px) and every other threshold were already pinned and were not edited. Recorded as IR-H95-005.
rename_note: Round frozen and executed in this session as H84 (runner scripts/run_h84.py, evidence/h84_*.json, submission prefix gems52-h84-straindipole-). At merge time origin/main already held an H84 round from a parallel session (an elliptical spatial-covariance anisotropy detector, gems52-h84-hva-ellipse-B-37654px-20261010T204630Z) plus H85-H94, so this round was renamed to H95, the next free identifier, following the IR-H71-005 / IR-H74-002 / IR-H82-008 precedent. The rename is IDENTIFIER-ONLY and that is provable rather than asserted: knowledge/93 is a byte-for-byte copy of knowledge/74 with the token H84->H95 substituted, the frozen text's own SHA-256 is preserved here as pre_rename_sha256, and the measured numbers in evidence/h95_{setup,channels,fit,holdout,independence,build}.json are the moved outputs of the executed run, not recomputed ones. The stages that were re-run after the rename are write, lane, reasoning and card: write re-stamps the filename and note, and lane HAD to be re-run because origin/main added ten further rounds of rasters to the census. The GeoTIFF's pixel pattern is unchanged; its SHA-256 changes only because the filename is part of the name, and the ZIP's SHA-256 changes because a ZIP stores its inner member's filename.
